notes.title: EMPTY SHELL release
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

This is it: the full version of EMPTY SHELL will be released on October 16, 10am PST, right after the Next Fest ends.
The Demo will no longer be available, but i'll update the Prologue around Halloween with the latest version you were able to try during the Next Fest.

The full experience brings a whole lot more:

 You'll travel throughout the entire Facility, visiting all the new locations to complete the list of tasks given to you
 Lots of new monstrosities will hunt you down
 New disturbing bosses
 Plenty of new weapons, from old war equipment to futuristic prototypes
 Upgrade your volunteers with new stats to give them a better chance of surviving
 Several new automated Gadgets and Devices will help you get through this nightmare
 Dozens of new achievements
 Secret rooms to discover and secret items to collect
 Dozens of documents to finally uncover the mistery of what happened during the 1950s


If you played the new Demo or the Prologue, your saves will be carried over the full game, so you can pick up from where you left (or start fresh, you choose).

The price of the full game will be 11.99$, but there will be a time-limited release discount, so come and get your copy: the operation needs a new volunteer and the Facility is waiting for you.

notes.title: Full Game Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

So, this is it: EMPTY SHELL will be released on October 16.
After months of development, I am very happy to say that the time has come and I am looking forward to delivering the full experience to you.

See you in the Facility, then.

notes.title: A quick update on the full version
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

The full version of the game is shaping up nicely and there's already lots of new content.

I wanted to share with you a new simple yet interesting mechanic. It's nothing revolutionary, but it adds a little more to exploration, and many players asked for it in the past weeks, so i've worked on it yesterday.

Here's an example of a secret room.
